items.title: Context engineering: managing context quality for more efficient, effective AI
items.summary: In 2025, companies spent a collective $581 billion on AI. The results were underwhelming: according to a study by MIT, 95% of Enterprise AI pilots showed zero impact on organization’s bottom lines. In short, the vast majority of AI pilots are unsuccessful. The reflex is to blame the models.
